  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for MISO with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. The study will use only admissible decision-time variables and will not modify raw data. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",

    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",

    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "confirm_no_raw_data_modification_and_no_future_information",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_step_days_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "report_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_finalization"
  ]
}
